entries.name: default
entries.prompt: Create one portrait 9:16 underwater aquarium game background, full bleed, soft polished hand-painted illustration matching the supplied reference's palette and gentle painting style. Refactor to an elegant MINIMAL environment: 85-90% calm open water negative space, subtle atmospheric gradients and soft broad light shafts, faint distant seabed, clean low-contrast sand along bottom 10%. Decorative plants/rocks confined to tiny bottom corners, no tall framing clutter, no detailed rock walls, no animals or fish, no UI or text, no glitter or bubble confetti. Beautiful natural water depth rather than flat color. Clear turquoise daytime water, warm ivory sand, just two small rounded stones and a little sea grass at bottom corners.
